description: This Java class defines the RetrieveAttribute command used in the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides functionality to retrieve a single attribute from a 'Thing' identified by its ID and a JSON pointer. The class includes methods for creating instances from JSON, specific IDs, and for building JSON payloads, along with metadata such as headers and resource paths.

classes.name: RetrieveAttribute
classes.description: Immutable command class to retrieve a specific attribute of a Thing based on its ID and JSON pointer. Implements methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and equality checks.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a RetrieveAttribute command given a ThingId, JSON pointer, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string or JSON object, parsing and validating fields accordingly.

methods.name: getAttributePointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer of the attribute to be retrieved.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing related to this command.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer representing the resource path for this attribute retrieval.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command's payload into a JSON object builder, considering schema version and predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of RetrieveAttribute with the provided headers.
